message.content:
The shop that is hiring the largest number of employees is:

FINAL SQL:
```sql
SELECT s.Name
FROM shop s
JOIN hiring h ON s.Shop_ID = h.Shop_ID
GROUP BY s.Shop_ID, s.Name
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT Shop_ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM hiring
        GROUP BY Shop_ID
    )
);
```
